dedupe_keys.name: geotechnical site characterization with 3 d seismic waveform tomography

description: Geotechnical Site Characterization with 3-D Seismic Waveform Tomography is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Khiem Tran, University of Florida (ufl.edu). We have successfully developed an advanced 3D FWI method using surface-based seismic wavefields for geotechnical site characterization. The method is based on the solution of 3D elastic wave equations, and Gauss-Newton inversion approach. The capabilities of the developed 3D FWI method has been tested on both synthetic and several field experimental datasets. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: 3D Full-waveform Inversion, Geotechnical site characterization, Sinkhole detection. Published 2020-11-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
